create_precision_metric: create a Precision metric instance to evaluate object detection model predictions against ground truth targets
test_precision_update_compute: test the Precision metric by updating with predictions and targets detections then computing precision scores at IoU thresholds
review_precision_reset: review the Precision metric reset method that clears stored predictions and targets for reuse
summarize_precision_result_properties: summarize the PrecisionResult dataclass properties including precision_at_50, precision_at_75, precision_scores and per-class precision
run_precision_plot: run the PrecisionResult plot method to visualize precision scores by object size category as a bar chart
